bootstrap.resampling: the judge's stationary bootstrap over the date-ordered days that are not risk dates (metrics.stationary_bootstrap_indices), one resample per replication shared by every cell. A statistic that is undefined on a resample is left out of that cell's draws and counted beside the interval. The reliability fit is bootstrapped for the pooled cell only

declaration.multiplicity: five rows at five leads are read; at a 90% interval about one cell in ten with no skill would show an interval that excludes its null by chance
declaration.outcome: the day is a pressure day at +5 bp, the judge's primary threshold and outcome, read from the judge's own fold grid
declaration.population: every scored day of 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31 at the lead on which announcement_dating_rescore.risk_flag(splits, values, True) is false (the settlement columns and their coupon clause are read at every lead, as the rows are scored), at each lead 1 to 5 apart

rows.risk_gbm+every_day+gate+settle+h41+iorb: the control row of #579 (PR #582): the every-day part is a ridge logistic on the spread and the SOFR 75th and 99th percentiles above IORB, then the gate of #532
rows.risk_gbm+every_day+gate+settle+h41+iorb+: the same row with the tail-spread cap of #601 (PR #609), kept only at or below the 0.75 quantile of the trailing 250 scored days
the cap row floored at the walk-forward rate of pressure days among the earlier days that were not risk dates (#610, PR #612)
that floor over the most recent 60 earlier such days (#610, PR #612)
that floor per as-of reserve-scarcity state (#610, PR #612)

declaration.rows_reading: the forecasts are those the repository scores, regenerated from the tracked fixtures with the commands in the result page. The risk-date part of every row is out of this measurement: only the days that are not risk dates are read
declaration.skill_beyond_the_base_rate: a row has skill beyond the base rate at a lead if its Brier skill interval excludes 0 from above and its AUROC interval excludes 0.5 from above. Stated before the first score; either alone is reported as such

splits.regime: the judge's regime labels (metadata/evaluation_splits.json), by calendar date; no hindsight regime label (ruling on #515)
splits.scarcity_state: the reserve-scarcity state as of each forecast's decision instant at its own lead (pressure_judge._scarcity_states), 0 to 3 or unknown

statistics.auroc: the chance that a pressure day's forecast is above a non-pressure day's, ties half (pressure_judge.auroc); 0.5 is no ranking
statistics.brier_skill: 1 less the row's Brier score over that of the walk-forward climatology, on the days on which the climatology exists
statistics.clip: a forecast is clipped to [1e-4, 1 - 1e-4] before its logit
statistics.reliability: the logistic recalibration of the outcome on the logit of the forecast, by Newton's method, on the days on which the forecast is above 1e-4 (the row forecasts exactly 0 on the others; their number and the pressure days on them are reported beside it). A calibrated forecast has intercept 0 and slope 1; a slope of 0 ranks nothing
statistics.walk_forward_climatology: per judge refit block, the pooled rate of pressure days among the earlier scored days that were not risk dates and whose outcome was observable at the block's fit (probability_calibration.past_positions); none while those days number fewer than 60 (group_calibration.GROUP_MINIMUM_PAIRS). It reads no later day (group_calibration.fit_floor refuses a pair after the fit)

declaration.status: declared by the pull request that closes #624 before any score of step 1; a measurement, not a record. Step 1 only: it describes forecasts the repository already scores. Nothing here is published: no rule, threshold or availability time changes, no 2026 day is scored, and the live record and pin do not move. The days read are 2018-2025, so a result is a description of that history and not a confirmation (ruling of 11 October 2026 on #567)
